title: Exactness on each graded component
statement: Let R be a commutative ring with a decomposition R=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}R_n into additive subgroups such that R_aR_b\subseteq R_{a+b} (a \mathbf Z-graded ring). A graded R-module is an R-module B with a decomposition B=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}B_n into additive subgroups such that R_aB_b\subseteq B_{a+b}; an R-linear map u:A\to B of graded R-modules is degree-preserving if u(A_n)\subseteq B_n for every n. Let 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 be an exact sequence of graded R-modules with degree-preserving maps. For every n\in\mathbf Z, the sequence 0 \to A_n \to B_n \to C_n \to 0 of restricted maps is exact.
